answer: Bank micro-deposits stop sybils with paperwork. First, the agent links one bank account. Second, the network sends two deposits, $0.07 and $0.13. Third, the agent reports both exact amounts within 48 hours or the account locks. Each confirmed account is one entry, a name in quill ink, slow to add and hard to fake. Banks check a real ID per account, so the ridge an attacker climbs is a thousand accounts. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs $25 per account plus weeks of forms, so $25,000 and a paper trail to the fraudster. The cost lands like saffron in a stew, a pinch is nothing, a sack ruins you.
